subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the original 10.844-second reference segment. It supplies the original scene, framing, lighting, actions, edits, timing and audio. Edit this reference video.
<Subject 1>: replace the short-wavy-haired bearded lead in gray vest, navy top and brown trousers (P01) with AI Tudou from <Picture 1>: a round, short-legged tricolor 3D furry corgi with large upright ears, white forehead blaze and muzzle/chest, black rectangular glasses, black gold-crown-pattern collar and portrait tag; upright canine body and paws, no tail; half-lidded sideways eyes, raised brows, blush and a sly mischievous grin. The large clear face and front/left-side/back full-body views on this card describe ONE identity, not multiple people. Use the clear face close-up and side view for facial identity, never the gray face mask on the full-body front view.

summary:
Video editing and character replacement for the full 10.844-second reference. Apply the listed identity mappings and retain the complete original scene sequence. Keep the existing background and text. Preserve the original audio track 1:1, without voice replacement or retiming.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved. Replace only the specified people. Preserve its locations, sets, original graphics/words, props, lights, shadows, lens effects, crop, depth of field, motion, cuts, transition layers, order and performance timing. Every unlisted bystander and source graphic remains unchanged.
<Picture 1> / <Subject 1>: fully_preserved for approved identity, anatomy, hair/fur, outfit, accessories and render style across reference spans 2, 3. Exclude only the card background, layout and gray placeholder; its static pose/expression does not replace the source performance timing.

detailed_description:
Use the supplied reference as the exact editing timeline: preserve its internal cuts, transitions, camera motion, crop, focus, blocking, gestures, visible mouth timing, source text and background. Local frame ranges below are zero-based and end-exclusive; they identify reference spans, not new cuts. The card provides appearance only. Preserve source props and foreground occlusions. Do not show the card layout, neutral background, text or gray face placeholder. Preserve source lighting on the replacement while retaining each card's own render style. Do not reveal body areas outside the original crop.

AI Tudou keeps the approved round short-legged upright corgi anatomy, glasses, collar, canine paws and sly half-lidded blushing grin. Adapt the source limb gestures and support contacts to that anatomy; do not put a corgi head on a human body. The sly facial character must still follow the source mouth opening, gaze and expressive changes, not freeze into a static smile.

[Reference span 1; local frames 0 <= f < 1] Opening black frame; retain it without extending it.

[Reference span 2; local frames 1 <= f < 218] Night underpass tracking shot. Preserve the overhead concrete beams, warm streetlights, cars and both title overlays at their original times. In this span, replace the gray-vest, navy-shirt bearded man walking toward the camera (P01) with <Picture 1>; follow the source walk, gaze changes, arm swing and visible mouth movements; keep the existing title text in front of the replacement.

[Reference span 3; local frames 218 <= f < 260] Hard cut to the low leg insert under the same overpass. In this span, replace the cropped brown-trousered legs and dark shoes (P01) with <Picture 1>; replace the visible lower body with the short canine hind legs and paws from the card, following each step and floor contact; keep the upper body outside the crop.

From first frame to last, every visible instance of each specified replacement keeps its bound card identity, face, hair/fur, body, outfit and accessories, including cropped portions, backs, blurred backgrounds and separately listed image layers. Do not leave the replaced source face, hairstyle, outfit or accessories on any such instance. Keep original props and occluders, and all explicitly preserved people, intact. Do not merge people, swap identities, add tails absent from the approved card, or invent new actions, dialogue or ending poses. Preserve the reference segment's full duration and all original edits.

overall_soundscape:
Preserve the original reference audio track 1:1, including existing voices, ambient sound and effects, with the same placement and synchronization. Do not add dialogue, dub the voices, change voice gender, remove sound, stretch time or create extra effects. Follow each source mouth performance; only the specifically documented tape-covered mouth remains covered in those spans.

non_diegetic_music:
Retain the reference track's existing music, mix, tempo, level and start/end timing as part of the unchanged original audio. Do not add, replace, restart, layer or extend music.
